3	import (

14		"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/agent/types"
15		"github.com/entireio/cli/cmd/entire/cli/paths"
16	)
17	
18	const entireManagedSearchSubagentMarker = "ENTIRE-MANAGED SEARCH SUBAGENT v1"
19	
20	type searchSubagentScaffoldStatus string
21	
22	const (
23		searchSubagentUnsupported     searchSubagentScaffoldStatus = "unsupported"
24		searchSubagentCreated         searchSubagentScaffoldStatus = "created"
25		searchSubagentUpdated         searchSubagentScaffoldStatus = "updated"
26		searchSubagentUnchanged       searchSubagentScaffoldStatus = "unchanged"
27		searchSubagentSkippedConflict searchSubagentScaffoldStatus = "skipped_conflict"
28	)
29	
30	type searchSubagentScaffoldResult struct {
31		Status  searchSubagentScaffoldStatus
32		RelPath string
33	}
34	
35	func scaffoldSearchSubagent(ctx context.Context, ag agent.Agent) (searchSubagentScaffoldResult, error) {
36		relPath, content, ok := searchSubagentTemplate(ag.Name())
37		if !ok {
38			return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{Status: searchSubagentUnsupported}, nil
39		}
40	
41		repoRoot, err := paths.WorktreeRoot(ctx)
42		if err != nil {
43			repoRoot, err = os.Getwd() //nolint:forbidigo // Intentional fallback when WorktreeRoot() fails in tests
44			if err != nil {
45				return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to get current directory: %w", err)
46			}
47		}
48	
49		targetPath := filepath.Join(repoRoot, relPath)
50		return writeManagedSearchSubagent(targetPath, relPath, content)
51	}
52	
53	func writeManagedSearchSubagent(targetPath, relPath string, content []byte) (searchSubagentScaffoldResult, error) {
54		existingData, err := os.ReadFile(targetPath) //nolint:gosec // target path is derived from repo root + fixed relative path
55		if err == nil {
56			if !bytes.Contains(existingData, []byte(entireManagedSearchSubagentMarker)) {
57				return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{
58					Status:  searchSubagentSkippedConflict,
59					RelPath: relPath,
60				}, nil
61			}
62			if bytes.Equal(existingData, content) {
63				return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{
64					Status:  searchSubagentUnchanged,
65					RelPath: relPath,
66				}, nil
67			}
68			if err := os.WriteFile(targetPath, content, 0o600); err != nil {
69				return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to update managed search subagent: %w", err)
70			}
71			return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{
72				Status:  searchSubagentUpdated,
73				RelPath: relPath,
74			}, nil
75		}
76		if !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
77			return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to read search subagent: %w", err)
78		}
79	
80		if err := os.MkdirAll(filepath.Dir(targetPath), 0o750); err != nil {
81			return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create search subagent directory: %w", err)
82		}
83		if err := os.WriteFile(targetPath, content, 0o600); err != nil {
84			return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to write search subagent: %w", err)
85		}
86	
87		return searchSubagentScaffoldResult{
88			Status:  searchSubagentCreated,
89			RelPath: relPath,
90		}, nil
91	}
92	
93	func reportSearchSubagentScaffold(w io.Writer, ag agent.Agent, result searchSubagentScaffoldResult) {
94		switch result.Status {
95		case searchSubagentCreated:
96			fmt.Fprintf(w, "Installed %s search subagent at %s\n", ag.Type(), result.RelPath)
97		case searchSubagentUpdated:
98			fmt.Fprintf(w, "Updated %s search subagent at %s\n", ag.Type(), result.RelPath)
99		case searchSubagentSkippedConflict:
100			fmt.Fprintf(
101				w,
102				"Skipped %s search subagent at %s because an unmanaged file already exists there\n",
103				ag.Type(),
104				result.RelPath,
105			)
106		case searchSubagentUnsupported, searchSubagentUnchanged:
107			// Nothing to report.
108		}
109	}

111	func searchSubagentTemplate(agentName types.AgentName) (string, []byte, bool) {
112		switch agentName {
113		case agent.AgentNameClaudeCode:
114			return filepath.Join(".claude", "agents", "search.md"), []byte(strings.TrimSpace(claudeSearchSubagentTemplate) + "\n"), true
115		case agent.AgentNameCodex:
116			return filepath.Join(".codex", "agents", "search.toml"), []byte(strings.TrimSpace(codexSearchSubagentTemplate) + "\n"), true
117		case agent.AgentNameGemini:
118			return filepath.Join(".gemini", "agents", "search.md"), []byte(strings.TrimSpace(geminiSearchSubagentTemplate) + "\n"), true
119		default:
120			return "", nil, false
121		}
122	}
